article_content: Mark Zuckerberg celebrated his anniversary with Priscilla Chan and introduced a new Facebook video feature on Friday. Unfortunately, the new service’s link was broken, so users could not create similar anniversary videos. Zuckerberg's anniversary video, which highlighted their 11-year journey through shared memories, failed to connect with Facebook users due to a link error. The couple, who are married and have no children, shared their cherished moments together, including their time at Harvard, hosting Thanksgiving celebrations, and spending time with their dog, Beast. Zuckerberg and Chan, who have a combined worth of $17 billion, were married in May 2012.

article_content: The renowned BBC authority, Lord Hall, has called for British households that have neglected to pay the TV Licence fee, particularly those that've only watched BBC content on iPlayer, to settle their dues. Capita, which governs the TV Licence fee, underscores a sizable recruitment effort to multiply its force of 'enforcement officers', offering grants that can vertically boost their income. BBC chiefs and Culture Secretary Sajid Javid have resonated with public concerns by pledging a critical assessment of the ongoing enforcement mannerism, to question if such tactics are fair and necessary.

La empresa Capita, que maneja la licencia televisiva, resalta un esfuerzo de reclutamiento significativo para aumentar su personal de agentes de enforcement, ofreciendo incentivos que podrían incrementar verticalmente sus ingresos.
